decisions.Trigger: Pumper 1 is the first crew on scene. Time for a first plan.

Card.headline: Cool A6 and A4 and shelter both communities

actions.reason: Pumper 1 can stop spread to the hottest neighbour.
Pumper 2 should cool the other close neighbour on arrival.
Protect Glenvale homes before HF smoke arrives.
Protect Glenvale Primary early while smoke direction remains unconfirmed.

Card.rationale: Let A5 burn and keep crews upwind beyond 17 metres. Cooling both close neighbours matched cooling B6 with less crew exposure.
evidence: A6 battery sensor reads 33 C and rises 5 C each minute.
The site wind meter reads from 287 degrees at 5.4 metres per second.
The forecast gives A6 a 74% runaway chance within 20 minutes.
Card.confidence_reason: Both tests support early cooling, but independent temperature and wind checks are unavailable.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If Aerial 1 finds hotter neighbours or different smoke drift, change assignments.
sensor_concerns: B6 battery sensor is flat beside the incident, so tests assumed 45 C.
The wind meter has no independent smoke drift check.
Fixed gas readings are noisy and HAZMAT 1 has not verified them.

Card.headline: Keep the current plan
Card.rationale: Keep Pumper 1 cooling A6 and Pumper 2 assigned to A4. Let A5 burn and keep Glenvale homes and Glenvale Primary sheltered.
evidence: A4 battery sensor reads 27 C and rising.
A6 battery sensor reads 28 C and falling under cooling.
The site wind meter reads wind from the west at 5.5 metres per second.
Card.confidence_reason: The tested orders contain spread, but independent temperature and wind checks remain unavailable.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If Aerial 1 finds hotter neighbours or smoke drifting another way.
sensor_concerns: The wind meter has no independent smoke drift check yet.
Fixed gas readings are noisy and HAZMAT 1 has not verified them.

Card.headline: Keep the current plan
Card.rationale: Keep Pumper 1 cooling A6 and Pumper 2 cooling A4 while A5 burns. Keep Glenvale homes and Glenvale Primary sheltered because extra cooling showed no benefit.
evidence: A4 battery sensor reads 44 C and rises 6 C per minute.
A6 battery sensor reads 25 C and is falling under cooling.
The site wind sensor reports wind from the west at 4.8 metres per second.
Card.confidence_reason: Testing supports current orders, but independent wind and temperature checks are unavailable.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If Aerial 1 finds hotter neighbours or smoke drifting toward crews, change assignments.
sensor_concerns: A5 reports zero gas despite visible fire, so it cannot establish safe entry.

decisions.Trigger: Aerial 1 has arrived. Its thermal camera can now check temperatures and see where the smoke goes.

Card.headline: Keep the current plan
Card.rationale: Keep Pumper 1 cooling A6 and Pumper 2 cooling A4 while A5 burns. Keep Glenvale homes and Glenvale Primary sheltered, as another stream showed no benefit.
evidence: Aerial 1's camera shows A6 skin at 25 C.
Aerial 1 reports smoke drifting east southeast, agreeing with the wind sensor.
Aerial 1's camera suggests B6 is about 53 C inside.

expected_effect.label: Peak indoor HF at Glenvale homes

Card.confidence_reason: Corrected temperature tests support current orders, but future wind changes remain uncertain.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If smoke turns toward crews or temperatures climb despite cooling, change assignments.
sensor_concerns: B4's battery sensor is flat beside the fire, so tests used the camera estimate of 34 C.
B6's camera estimate exceeds its battery reading, so tests used 53 C.
Fixed gas readings are unverified and cannot justify opening an enclosure.

decisions.Trigger: HAZMAT 1 has arrived. It can measure gas and the smoke reaching nearby homes.

Card.headline: Keep the current plan
Card.rationale: Keep Pumper 1 cooling A6 and Pumper 2 cooling A4. Keep Glenvale homes and Glenvale Primary sheltered because HF smoke is reaching homes.
evidence: Home air monitoring reads HF at 0.7 ppm.
A6 battery sensor reads 37 C and falling under cooling.
B6 battery sensor reads 56 C and rising 4 C each minute.
Card.confidence_reason: Adding B6 cooling showed no spread benefit, but B6 is still heating.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If B6 keeps heating or HF at homes rises, reassess immediately.
sensor_concerns: A3 and A6 fixed gas readings exceed HAZMAT 1 readings, so trust HAZMAT 1.

decisions.Trigger: Pumper 3 has arrived. Its tanker means a fourth hose can run.

Card.headline: Keep the current plan
Card.rationale: Keep Pumper 1 cooling A6 and Pumper 2 cooling A4, with both Glenvale communities sheltered. Extra hoses showed no benefit even with B6 assumed hotter, so conserve water.
evidence: Aerial 1's thermal camera shows B6 skin at 58 C.
The B6 battery sensor shows 66 C, rising 0.3 C each minute.
The Glenvale homes air monitor reads HF at 0.02 ppm.
Card.confidence_reason: Extra cooling showed no benefit in 16 simulations, but future wind changes remain uncertain.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If B6 keeps heating or smoke turns toward Glenvale, reassess immediately.
sensor_concerns: B6's camera suggests about 87 C inside, so tests used that higher temperature.
B2's fixed gas detector reads 13 percent, but HAZMAT 1 verifies only 0.2 percent.

decisions.Trigger: Regular check that the plan is still right.

Card.headline: Keep the current plan
Card.rationale: Keep Pumper 1 cooling A6 and Pumper 2 cooling A4. Keep Glenvale homes and Glenvale Primary sheltered while A5 burns.
evidence: Aerial 1 reports smoke drifting southeast, away from both communities.
The thermal camera shows A4 at 19 C and A6 at 32 C.
The B6 battery sensor reads 91 C, rising 0.2 C each minute.
Card.confidence_reason: Sensors agree and extra B6 cooling showed no benefit, but wind changes remain uncertain.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If smoke turns toward communities or B6 heats faster, change the plan.
sensor_concerns: The fixed B2 gas detector reads 11%, but HAZMAT 1 verifies about 1%.

decisions.Trigger: B6 is heating up. It is at 100°C and rising.

Card.headline: Have Aerial 1 cool B6 now

actions.reason: Cool B6 before further heating makes water less effective.

Card.rationale: Keep Pumper 1 and Pumper 2 cooling A6 and A4, with Glenvale homes and Glenvale Primary sheltered. Add one stream to B6 from upwind, keeping crews beyond 17 metres.
evidence: B6 battery sensor reads 100 C, rising 1.5 C each minute.
Aerial 1 thermal camera supports about 103 C inside B6.
Aerial 1 reports smoke drifting southeast, agreeing with the wind sensor.
Card.confidence_reason: Independent readings confirm heating, but neither cooling option reduced simulated spread.
Card.would_change_my_mind: If B6 starts cooling steadily, reconsider the extra stream.
sensor_concerns: A6 fixed gas detector reads 17%, but HAZMAT 1 verifies zero.
B1 and B2 fixed gas readings exceed HAZMAT 1 readings.
